title: Workflow
description: workflows/<code>.yaml: ordered steps, each done by a skill or an agent, with the checks that have to hold before the next step is handed out. In a tool with slash commands it arrives as a command, elsewhere as a skill; either way the command line hands the steps out one at a time.

use.description: The code of the skill or agent that does the step. It is installed along with the workflow.

with.description: Codes of further resources the step uses, such as a knowledge base.

checks.description: What has to hold at the end of the step. The next step is only handed out once every check has passed.

by.description: ai: the AI checks it and states its evidence; command: the command line runs "run" in the project's directory and it passes with exit code 0; human: the person confirms it.

run.description: The command of a check by command, run by the system's shell.

forbid.description: What must not be done in this step.

then.description: continue: once the checks have passed, the next step is handed out; confirm: it waits for the person to say so.
